name: Sanctions & coercion
value: EU 22nd package due; adoption aimed by Christmas
summary: EU to unveil its 22nd Russia sanctions package, aiming to adopt it by Christmas; US made new listings on 19 Nov
state: EU foreign policy chief Kallas said on 16 Nov the 22nd package against Russia would be presented in the coming days, with Commission talks with member states under way and adoption targeted by Christmas (UNN). The EU added 145 entries to its sanctions lists on 16 Nov. On 19 Nov the US Treasury designated 'Ndrangheta associates and South-East Asian cyber-scam operators and amended a licence for the sale of Lukoil International (OFAC). No major economy has been cut off from payment systems, so Watch holds.
for_you: Firms trading with Russia or using affected banking and shipping channels face tighter compliance checks. UK businesses can check current measures in OFSI guidance.
rubric_hit: Major new EU package in preparation; no payment-system cut-off = Watch

sources.title: UNN — The EU will present its 22nd package of sanctions against Russia in the coming days: Kallas

why: Sanctions are now a frontline weapon; secondary sanctions and asset seizures fragment global finance and trade.
drivers: Russia/Iran sanctions packages, secondary sanctions, frozen-asset decisions, export controls.
